# Microdancing

> A blog of microposts, marginal notes, and chronicles of the minimal. Built with pandoc and a custom bash build system; deployed as a bilingual static site.

Home of the Resonant Coding manifesto — a philosophy for working with AI in software development that emphasizes understanding over prompting, and design decisions over vibe.

## Key Posts

- [Resonant Coding (es)](https://charly-vibes.github.io/microdancing/es/posts/resonant-coding.html): The manifesto
- [Resonant Coding — Practical Guide (es)](https://charly-vibes.github.io/microdancing/es/posts/resonant-coding-guia.html): How to apply it

## Structure

Content lives in `content/posts/{lang}/` as Markdown files with YAML frontmatter. The build system is a bash script using pandoc for HTML conversion.

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

*[Leer en español](https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/)*
